'library(ggplot2)

dataset <- dataset[, 1:5]
colnames(dataset) <- c("user_name", "metric1", "metric2", "format1", "format2")

dataset$user_name <- as.character(dataset$user_name)
dataset$metric1 <- as.numeric(dataset$metric1)
dataset$metric2 <- as.numeric(dataset$metric2)
dataset$format1 <- as.character(dataset$format1)
dataset$format2 <- as.character(dataset$format2)

dataset <- dataset[!is.na(dataset$user_name) &
                   !is.na(dataset$metric1) &
                   !is.na(dataset$metric2), ]

dataset <- unique(dataset)

dataset <- dataset[order(tolower(dataset$user_name)), ]

if (nrow(dataset) == 0) stop("No usable rows found.")

compact_number <- function(x, decimals = 1) {
  out <- rep("", length(x))
  abs_x <- abs(x)

  idx <- !is.na(abs_x) & abs_x >= 1e9
  out[idx] <- paste0(format(round(x[idx] / 1e9, decimals), nsmall = decimals), "B")

  idx <- !is.na(abs_x) & abs_x >= 1e6 & abs_x < 1e9
  out[idx] <- paste0(format(round(x[idx] / 1e6, decimals), nsmall = decimals), "M")

  idx <- !is.na(abs_x) & abs_x >= 1e3 & abs_x < 1e6
  out[idx] <- paste0(format(round(x[idx] / 1e3, decimals), nsmall = decimals), "K")

  idx <- !is.na(abs_x) & abs_x < 1e3
  out[idx] <- format(round(x[idx], decimals), big.mark = ",", nsmall = decimals)

  out
}

format_label <- function(x, fmt, blank_zero = TRUE) {
  fmt <- trimws(fmt)
  fmt_lower <- tolower(fmt)

  if (fmt_lower == "currency") {
    out <- paste0("$", compact_number(x, 1))
  } else if (grepl("%", fmt)) {
    decimals <- ifelse(grepl("0\\.0", fmt), 1, 0)
    out <- paste0(format(round(x * 100, decimals), nsmall = decimals), "%")
  } else if (grepl("days", fmt_lower)) {
    out <- paste0(compact_number(x, 0), " days")
  } else if (grepl("hrs", fmt_lower)) {
    out <- paste0(compact_number(x, 2), " hrs")
  } else if (fmt == "#,0") {
    out <- compact_number(x, 0)
  } else {
    out <- compact_number(x, 2)
  }

  if (blank_zero) {
    out[!is.na(x) & x == 0] <- ""
  }

  out
}

axis_label <- function(x, fmt) {
  format_label(x, fmt, blank_zero = FALSE)
}

show_labels <- nrow(dataset) <= 25

m1_max <- max(dataset$metric1, na.rm = TRUE)
m2_max <- max(dataset$metric2, na.rm = TRUE)

if (m1_max == 0) m1_max <- 1
if (m2_max == 0) m2_max <- 1

scale_factor <- m1_max / m2_max

format1 <- unique(na.omit(dataset$format1))[1]
format2 <- unique(na.omit(dataset$format2))[1]

if (is.na(format1)) format1 <- "#,0"
if (is.na(format2)) format2 <- "#,0"

plot_data <- data.frame(
  user_name = rep(dataset$user_name, 2),
  metric_type = rep(c("Primary", "Secondary"), each = nrow(dataset)),
  value = c(dataset$metric1, dataset$metric2 * scale_factor),
  label = c(
    format_label(dataset$metric1, format1, blank_zero = TRUE),
    format_label(dataset$metric2, format2, blank_zero = TRUE)
  )
)

plot_data$user_name <- factor(plot_data$user_name, levels = dataset$user_name)

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = user_name, y = value, fill = metric_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Primary" = "#4A4C60",
      "Secondary" = "#B7C298"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) axis_label(x, format1),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / scale_factor,
      labels = function(x) axis_label(x, format2)
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Segoe UI") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#20222D", color = "#20222D"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#20222D", color = "#20222D"),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "#20222D"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "white", family = "Segoe UI"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "white", family = "Segoe UI"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 10, color = "white", family = "Segoe UI"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#44475A")
  )

if (show_labels) {
  p <- p + geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "white",
    family = "Segoe UI",
    fontface = "bold"
  )
}

p'
